title: Live and learn
simplified_paragraphs: 今年6月，家住上海的一位老人获得了中国美术学院的双学士学位，从中国画专业顺利毕业。老人名叫徐安玲，1951年出生，今年已经70岁了。
徐安玲现在还清楚地记得自己上大学的第一天。她走进教室时，一群二十多岁的年轻学生都以为她走错教室了，甚至有人以为她是哪位同学的家长。进入大学以后，繁重的学习带给她很大的压力。别的年轻学生每天练习3-4小时，她只能靠更勤奋的练习来弥补自己的不足。她永远是班上第一个到教室，最后一个离开的人。
她从小就喜欢用铅笔画画，参加工作以后忙碌的工作生活让她放下了画笔，但是这个爱好一直没变。退休后，在她58岁那年，她重新拿起了画笔。现在她终于顺利毕业了。家人们也都很支持她退休之后追寻梦想的做法。她也将自己的一部分作品留给家乡，因为那是自己的梦开始的地方。
traditional_paragraphs: 今年6月，家住上海的一位老人獲得了中國美術學院的雙學士學位，從中國畫專業順利畢業。老人名叫徐安玲，1951年出生，今年已經70歲了。
徐安玲現在還清楚地記得自己上大學的第一天。她走進教室時，一群二十多歲的年輕學生都以為她走錯教室了，甚至有人以為她是哪位同學的家長。進入大學以後，繁重的學習帶給她很大的壓力。別的年輕學生每天練習3-4小時，她只能靠更勤奮的練習來彌補自己的不足。她永遠是班上第一個到教室，最後一個離開的人。
她從小就喜歡用鉛筆畫畫，參加工作以後忙碌的工作生活讓她放下了畫筆，但是這個愛好一直沒變。退休後，在她58歲那年，她重新拿起了畫筆。現在她終於順利畢業了。家人們也都很支持她退休之後追尋夢想的做法。她也將自己的一部分作品留給家鄉，因為那是自己的夢開始的地方。
pinyin_paragraphs: jīn nián 6 yuè， jiā zhù Shàng hǎi de yī wèi lǎo rén huò dé le Zhōng guó Měi shù Xué yuàn de shuāng xué shì xué wèi， cóng Zhōng guó huà zhuān yè shùn lì bì yè。 lǎo rén míng jiào Xú Ān líng，1951 nián chū shēng， jīn nián yǐ jīng 70 suì le。

Xú Ān líng xiàn zài hái qīng chu de jì de zì jǐ shàng dà xué de dì yī tiān。 tā zǒu jìn jiào shì shí， yī qún èr shí duō suì de nián qīng xué shēng dōu yǐ wéi tā zǒu cuò jiào shì le， shèn zhì yǒu rén yǐ wéi tā shì něi wèi tóng xué de jiā zhǎng。 jìn rù dà xué yǐ hòu， fán zhòng de xué xí dài gěi tā hěn dà de yā lì。 bié de nián qīng xué shēng měi tiān liàn xí 3-4 xiǎo shí， tā zhǐ néng kào gèng qín fèn de liàn xí lái mí bǔ zì jǐ de bù zú。 tā yǒng yuǎn shì bān shàng dì yī gè dào jiào shì， zuì hòu yī gè lí kāi de rén。

tā cóng xiǎo jiù xǐ huan yòng qiān bǐ huà huà， cān jiā gōng zuò yǐ hòu máng lù de gōng zuò shēng huó ràng tā fàng xià le huà bǐ， dàn shì zhè gè ài hào yī zhí méi biàn。 tuì xiū hòu， zài tā 58 suì nà nián， tā chóng xīn ná qǐ le huà bǐ。 xiàn zài tā zhōng yú shùn lì bì yè le。 jiā rén men yě dōu hěn zhī chí tā tuì xiū zhī hòu zhuī xún mèng xiǎng de zuò fǎ。 tā yě jiāng zì jǐ de yī bù fen zuò pǐn liú gěi jiā xiāng， yīn wèi nà shì zì jǐ de mèng kāi shǐ de dì fang。
english_paragraphs: This June, an older woman from Shanghai graduated from the China Academy of Art with a dual bachelor’s degree in Chinese painting. Her name is Xu Anling. She was born in 1951 and is now 70 years old.

Xu Anling still clearly remembers her first day in college. When she walked into the classroom, a group of young students in their twenties thought she was in the wrong classroom. Some even thought she was the parent of a certain classmate. After entering college, the heavy study put a lot of pressure on her. Other young students practice 3-4 hours a day, but she can only make up for her shortcomings by practicing more diligently. She was always the first one in class to arrive and the last one to leave.

She has been fond of drawing with pencils since she was a child. After joining the workforce, her busy work life made her put down her painting brush, but this hobby has never changed. After retiring, at the age of 58, she took up painting again. Now she has finally graduated successfully. Her family also supports her pursuit of her dreams after retirement. She also left some of her works to her hometown, because that is where her dreams began.
english_full:
This June, an older woman from Shanghai graduated from the China Academy of Art with a dual bachelor’s degree in Chinese painting. Her name is Xu Anling. She was born in 1951 and is now 70 years old.

Xu Anling still clearly remembers her first day in college. When she walked into the classroom, a group of young students in their twenties thought she was in the wrong classroom. Some even thought she was the parent of a certain classmate. After entering college, the heavy study put a lot of pressure on her. Other young students practice 3-4 hours a day, but she can only make up for her shortcomings by practicing more diligently. She was always the first one in class to arrive and the last one to leave.

She has been fond of drawing with pencils since she was a child. After joining the workforce, her busy work life made her put down her painting brush, but this hobby has never changed. After retiring, at the age of 58, she took up painting again. Now she has finally graduated successfully. Her family also supports her pursuit of her dreams after retirement. She also left some of her works to her hometown, because that is where her dreams began.
